hero.eyebrow: Secret Santa for family and friends
hero.title: Organize a Secret Santa with one link
hero.lead: Share a link with your family or friends so everyone can join. Givto draws the names and keeps the wishlists.
hero.note: Free. No passwords and no app to install.

create.title: Start a Secret Santa
create.description: Give it a name. Add a gift day and a budget if you like.

share.title: Share the link
share.description: Send the link to your family or friends. You don't need their email addresses.

join.title: Everyone joins
join.description: People open the link, enter their name and email and confirm with a code.

draw.title: Draw names
draw.description: When everyone's in, draw names. Each person only sees who they're buying for.

wishlists.title: Fill in your wishlist
wishlists.description: Add a few wishes so your Santa knows what to get you.

gift-day.title: Gift day
gift-day.description: Unwrap your gifts in turns, and end with the big reveal if you like.

wishlist.title: One wishlist for all your groups
wishlist.description: Keep one wishlist for every group you're in. Hide wishes from a group if you want.

dibs.title: Dibs!
dibs.description: Santas call Dibs! on what they're buying, so you don't get the same gift from two groups.

tips.title: Tips for Santa
tips.description: Leave a tip for someone's Santa, with your name or anonymously.

editions.title: Same again next year
editions.description: Next year, start again with the same group. Givto can make sure nobody gets the same person as last time.

account.question: Does everyone need an account?
account.answer: Just an email address. No password and no app.

secret.question: Who can see who drew whom?
secret.answer: Nobody, not even the organizer. You can end gift day with the big reveal if you like.

apart.question: Can I keep couples apart?
apart.answer: Yes. Put them in the same Keep apart row and they won't draw each other.

cost.question: What does it cost?
cost.answer: Nothing. Givto is free and open source.

data.question: What happens to my data?
data.answer: We only keep what your Secret Santa needs and delete it when it's no longer needed. Read the <link>privacy page</link>.
